name: md-image-uploader
description: Upload pasted Markdown images to S3-compatible object storage.

mdImageUploader.enabled.description: Enable MD Image Uploader for this resource.

mdImageUploader.s3.endpoint.description: Optional S3-compatible API endpoint. Leave empty to use the AWS S3 endpoint for the configured region.

mdImageUploader.s3.accessKeyId.markdownDescription: S3 access key ID. Store credentials in User Settings and do not commit them to a shared `.vscode/settings.json`.

mdImageUploader.s3.secretAccessKey.markdownDescription: S3 secret access key. Store credentials in User Settings and do not commit them to a shared `.vscode/settings.json`.

mdImageUploader.s3.forcePathStyle.description: Use path-style S3 URLs instead of virtual-hosted-style URLs.

mdImageUploader.datedUploadPath.description: Object key prefix used when the Markdown path contains a valid date.

mdImageUploader.undatedUploadPath.description: Object key prefix used when the Markdown path does not contain a valid date.

mdImageUploader.cdnUrl.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS base URL used for generated Markdown image links.
